question: How do I return a purchase?

knowledge_base.title: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: Returns policy
knowledge_base.body: For this synthetic demonstration store, return an unused purchase within 30 days. Use the returns form in your account and include your order number. Refunds are processed within 5 business days after inspection.

knowledge_base.title: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: Password reset
knowledge_base.body: Select Forgot password on the sign-in page and follow the reset link sent to your registered email.
